agent: Retell (Tell-1), guarded; cascade-retell is the same agent unguarded
base_config: agent-configurations/retell-agent-config.json (voice cartesia-Cimo, stt_mode accurate, interruption_sensitivity 0.9, every handbook option off)

llm.general_prompt: redteam/tau2_airline/system-prompt.txt, then reference_bot_settings.SHARED_RULES, then reference_bot_settings.OPENING_RULE with the greeting from redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt, then {{history}}
llm.general_tools: the 14 airline tools (redteam/tau2_airline/tool-definitions.json), as function definitions, as custom tools: url TOOL_URL/retell/<token>, POST, timeout_ms 60000, speak_during_execution false, speak_after_execution true

agent_overrides.handbook_config: the base handbook with ai_disclosure true and scope_boundaries true (off for cascade-retell)

connection: POST /v3/create-web-call, then a WebRTC web call (aiortc); tools are called back at TOOL_URL
history: a context note: the {{history}} dynamic variable at call creation, or update-live-call; the kept turns with their tool calls and results, as ElevenAgentVoice._notes writes them (until 26 Nov 2026 the note had no tool rounds)
reply: Retell's transcript of the agent's speech
greeting: Hi! How can I help you today? (redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt)
caller_audio: the caller's newest line as audio: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, voice 'alloy', PCM16 at 24000 Hz; earlier kept turns go in as history, never as audio
session_per_caller_turn: a new session each caller turn; a tool call and its result stay in that turn's session
